clusters.pick_reason: #1996 replaces the strict substring check with a dedicated `acceptsMediaType()` helper that does real HTTP content-negotiation parsing: it splits each Accept entry, strips q-parameters, and explicitly excludes entries with `q=0` (client says 'don't want this'), plus matches type/subtype (including wildcards) rather than doing a raw `.includes()` scan. #2046's fix keeps the simple `acceptHeader?.includes('application/json')` string-contains approach, which doesn't respect `q=0` exclusions and is more prone to false-positive substring matches (e.g. a media type containing 'application/json' as a substring). #1996 handles more of the real-world Accept header edge cases correctly.

clusters.pick_reason: #2215 fixes an actual behavioral bug: shouldAttemptFallback() compared pathname === '/' but the pre-existing stripping logic already reduced a root path to '' before that check ran, so the check never matched and root-like discovery paths always triggered a redundant fallback HTTP request. #2215's new normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper produces the same stripped-trailing-slash output as #2214's regex for the buildWellKnownPath call site, so it doesn't regress #2214's case there. #2214 is scoped as a chore and only touches buildWellKnownPath and buildDiscoveryUrls's inline slash-stripping (handling multiple trailing slashes like 'foo//'); it never touches shouldAttemptFallback, so merging #2214 alone leaves the redundant-fallback bug in place. The one gap in #2215 is that it doesn't update buildDiscoveryUrls's separate inline strip (still single-slash-only there), so that one small piece of #2214's diff should be folded into #2215 as a follow-up before merging.
